name: fireball
description: Menu item: the player aims Fireball with its area following the cursor (Request Point); asks the GM before damaging the tokens in it.

Data.Label: Aim
Data.Message: Where does the Fireball go off? (20 ft radius)

Data.Label: Show the blast while the GM decides
Who was hit
Data.Script: return { hitCount: vars.hit.length, hitNames: vars.hit.map(function (t) { return t.name; }).join(", ") || "nobody" };

Data.Label: Ask the GM
Data.Message: Fireball by %playerName%: %fireDamage% fire damage to %hitNames%. Apply it?
